title: Prague Crawl 2027: speaker card
description: Announce a confirmed speaker: their photo in a gradient ring on the left, and Speaker, their name, company logo and role on the right, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). Fill in one per speaker. The default is Jason Grad as an example.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: One or two words, in capitals: Speaker, Keynote, Panelist, Demo.

fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: A square portrait with the face centred, at least 900 px wide; it's cropped to a circle.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Full name, in capitals. Wraps to two lines and shrinks to fit.

fields.label: Company logo
fields.hint: The company's logo for dark backgrounds (white or colour on black), PNG or SVG, wider than tall.

fields.label: Role
fields.hint: Job title only; the logo shows the company. Up to about 40 characters.
